# Browser libraries

Locally bundled from exact versions in backend/package-lock.json:

- @supabase/supabase-js 2.119.0 (MIT)
- Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause)
- Chart.js 4.6.1 (MIT)

Run `npm run build:vendor` after a reviewed dependency update. License notices are kept alongside the assets. These files are dependencies, not application source to edit directly. Map tiles and background footage remain external resources.
